I am an old man, 59 years, farming in North West here in the Sudan Savanna. This small plot of 0.25 hectare I put for beans with small millet mixed inside, because beans help the soil and feed the family. I have no money for much fertilizer, and the rain here is short, so I depend on my own hands and my family. I will use the seed I kept from last year like my fathers did, and put small manure from my goats on the land.
